{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma2
|version1= 1.00

|game2= arma2oa
|version2= 1.50

|game3= tkoh
|version3= 1.00

|game4= arma3
|version4= 0.50

|gr1= System

|descr= Set variable to given value in the variable space of given FSM.<br>
The FSM handle is the number returned by the [[execFSM]] command.

|s1= handle [[setFSMVariable]] [name, value]

|p1= handle: [[Number]] - FSM handle

|p2= name: [[String]] - name of the FSM variable

|p3= value: [[Anything]] - new value of the FSM variable

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
_handle = execFSM "test.fsm";
_handle setFSMVariable ["_foo", 23]; // sets variable _foo in the FSM to 23
</sqf>

|seealso= [[FSM]] [[commandFSM]] [[completedFSM]] [[doFSM]] [[execFSM]] [[getFSMVariable]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Master85
|timestamp= 20140323005300
|text= If the variable is not yet defined within the FSM it will be created.
